def test_server_runtime_classpath_uses_headless_backend():
        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                GRADLEW,
                "--no-daemon",
                "-q",
                ":server:dependencies",
                "--configuration",
                "runtimeClasspath",
            ],
            cwd=PROJECT_DIR,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=GRADLE_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
